decisions.decision: Doreen Noble will formally notify the Town Manager that she would like notification before COA funds are transferred.
decisions.quote: doreen informed the coa that she will formally let the town manager know that she would like notification before funds are transferred.

decisions.decision: The council is willing to meet with the Town Manager for discussion before funds are transferred in the future.
decisions.quote: the council is willing to meet with the town manager for discussion before funds are transferred in the future.

decisions.decision: Doreen Noble will petition for additional staff hours so money does not have to come from Utilities.
decisions.quote: doreen stated that she will also petition the need for additional hours, so money will not have to come from utilities to cover adequate staffing.

decisions.decision: Doreen Noble and Peter Lincoln will represent the Eagle House on the Parking Lot committee.
decisions.quote: doreen noble and peter lincoln will represent the eagle house on this committee.

decisions.decision: The COA requested that Lloyd Carlson send a letter to regional businesses asking for Parking Lot donations.
decisions.quote: the coa requested that lloyd carlson send a letter to businesses throughout the region asking for parking lot donations.

decisions.decision: Deb Seeley, willing to replace Emily Foster, will be invited to attend the June meeting.
decisions.quote: deb seeley is willing to serve replacing emily foster, and will be invited to attend the june meeting.

decisions.decision: The COA Barbecue/Volunteer Recognition Ceremony is set for Tuesday, July 20, at 11:00 a.m. at the Eagle House.
decisions.quote: the date will be tuesday, july 20, at 11:00a.m. at the eagle house.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Capital Planning Committee approved funding for the Parking Lot, and the next step is applying for the grant.
budget_items.quote: lloyd carlson reported that the capital planning committee has approved $10,000 for the parking lot.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY11 budget total was given at Town Meeting as a 9.25 total, which would be $105,000.
budget_items.quote: fy11 budget: given a 9.25 total at town meeting, which would be $105,000.

budget_items.topic: COA account transfer and staffing money
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Funds were transferred from the COA account before Town Meeting without the Director's knowledge; the Director will seek additional hours so money does not come from Utilities.
budget_items.quote: doreen noble reported that funds were transferred from the coa account prior to town meeting without her knowledge.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: No financial report was given this month; the April report was the last, and the final report is due at the June 8 meeting.
budget_items.quote: there was no financial report this month.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The CDBG grant is HUD funding for Parking Lot construction and Housing rehab in the census block around the Eagle House.
budget_items.quote: cdbg grant: this grant is hud funding for parking lot construction.

transfers.description: Funds transferred from the COA account prior to Town Meeting, without the Director's knowledge.
transfers.outcome: Transferred; the Director reported it, and the COA said it first learned of it at Town Meeting. The Director will ask the Town Manager for notice before future transfers.
transfers.quote: doreen noble reported that funds were transferred from the coa account prior to town meeting without her knowledge.
